title: Sodium-Ion Batteries Gain Ground as Lithium Alternative
description: Batteries have been a hot topic for years amid the energy transition rush of many governments, but now, it has become even hotter as the search for alternatives to traditional energy becomes frantic. While lithium continues to dominate in both EVs and storage…

analysis.summary: The newness of Sodium-Ion Batteries gaining attention as a Lithium Alternative is significant for geopolitical reasons, though the economic impact on global energy transition appears notable. The trend may require immediate attention but could evolve with broader adoption.
